note: Neutral daylight used for architectural review, not a claim about the weather or hour on any particular November 1945 day. No rainfall, smoke, fire or battle atmosphere is added; the brief forbids unsourced drama used to hide modelling weakness.

sky.note: Vertical gradient from a warm dust-hazed horizon to a cool zenith, in linear scene-referred colour.

sun.note: Late-morning tropical sun used to model the architecture; azimuth and elevation are chosen for readable shadows along the mapped streets, not derived from a dated ephemeris.

eevee.comment: Ambient occlusion via fast GI keeps shopfront recesses and eaves from reading flat without crushing shadows.
